items.check: Every machine-varying input the baseline captures (lxml backend presence, acoustid module, filesystem enumeration order, mtime) is either eliminated, pinned, or logged as an accepted decision

rewrite-from-reconnect writing cases: write_nml_safely branches on HAS_LXML, producing a different stats key set (mutate_tree pre-seeds four zeroed keys) and a different serialisation path; no decision records how the manifest stays valid on a machine whose lxml availability differs from the capture machine
DL-005 rejects the fingerprint case for machine-dependence; verify the same standard is applied to (or explicitly waived for) the lxml-dependent writing cases

planning_context.constraints requires rewrite-from-reconnect pinned in an ambiguous-match form; the case list and M-001 requirements narrow to dry-run/matched-writing/dangling-writing with no decision recording the drop. M-001 still carries the unresolved needs-rationale flag

No invariant, doc line or failure message states that PARITY_BASELINE_SHA256 may only be recomputed under review; the constant is a two-line edit that reproduces the exact regenerate-to-go-green anti-pattern the plan exists to prevent

task_spec permits stating the required CI check; context invisible_knowledge requires any tag-diffing CI job to also assert the tag resolves to its recorded SHA. Neither reaches a plan artifact, so the requirement dies with the session
R-004's mitigation (.git/hooks/pre-push) exists on this machine but is not version-controlled and appears in no milestone file list or documentation intent; a fresh clone silently loses the control

The set of normalised cases lives in a regenerate.py module-level set while the manifest carries a per-entry normalise_run_root field; two sources of truth that can drift if the manifest is edited or a case is reordered
Acceptance criterion 'altering one character of manifest.json on disk makes test_manifest_matches_pinned_hash fail' has no automated verification; CI-M-002-003 mutates in memory only
Each reasoning chain reaches an implication, not just a premise; each cited anchor (compare_cmd.py:L95, reconnect_cmd.py index_scan_roots call, _OUTPUT_ARG_INDEX) matches the repository as it stands
Every rejected alternative's decision_ref resolves to an existing decision and its rejection reason is falsifiable rather than preference
Each risk's mitigation is realised by a named code_intent, file or acceptance criterion rather than by prose alone
